title: Robin as Fortune-teller
year_evidence: 扉に『PUBLISHED BY THE AMERICAN FOLK-LORE SOCIETY … 1924』、序文の署名に『April, 1924.』
text:
Henry Spence, Bog, Westmoreland.

Robin fawn himself to be fortune-teller. So he bet a lot of money dat
whatever dey have fe dinner to-night, him will tell it. So Robin name
Fox,—call him “Mr. Fox Robin,”—an’ dey didn’t know his name. So it was
a fox underneat’ de dish fe de dinner. So when him come in, frighten’,
t’ink him goin’ to lose, him sit down, say, “Aye, poor Fox is caught
to-day!” When dey hear him say dis, everybody give a shout. Him win;
for it was a fox underneat’ de dish.

Once de good man again go out to shoot. So him coming home, hear about
Fox too,—same Fox. So him catch a robin redbreast an’ kill it an’ roast
it an’ put it under de dish de very same as dey do de fox. So at dinner
when he come to a certain time, say, “I want to know what underneat’ de
dish now, Mr. Fox?” So said, “Well, poor Robin is well caught to-day!”
paragraphs: Robin fawn himself to be fortune-teller. So he bet a lot of money dat whatever dey have fe dinner to-night, him will tell it. So Robin name Fox,—call him “Mr. Fox Robin,”—an’ dey didn’t know his name. So it was a fox underneat’ de dish fe de dinner. So when him come in, frighten’, t’ink him goin’ to lose, him sit down, say, “Aye, poor Fox is caught to-day!” When dey hear him say dis, everybody give a shout. Him win; for it was a fox underneat’ de dish.

Once de good man again go out to shoot. So him coming home, hear about Fox too,—same Fox. So him catch a robin redbreast an’ kill it an’ roast it an’ put it under de dish de very same as dey do de fox. So at dinner when he come to a certain time, say, “I want to know what underneat’ de dish now, Mr. Fox?” So said, “Well, poor Robin is well caught to-day!”
語り手 ヘンリー・スペンス(ウェストモーランド、ボグ)

ロビンが占い師のふりをした。それで、今夜の夕飯が何であろうと当ててみせると言って、大金を賭けた。ところでロビンの名はフォックスといって——「フォックス・ロビンさん」と呼ばれていた——みんなはその名を知らなかった。さて夕飯の皿の下には狐が入れてあった。ロビンは入ってきて、怖くなり、負けると思って、腰を下ろしてこう言った。「ああ、かわいそうな狐(フォックス)が今日は捕まった!」 これを聞いて、みんなはどっと声をあげた。ロビンの勝ちだった。皿の下には狐がいたのだから。

あるとき旦那がまた狩りに出かけた。帰ってくる道すがら、またあの狐(フォックス)の話を聞いた——同じフォックスのことである。そこで旦那は駒鳥(ロビン)を一羽捕まえて殺し、焼いて、狐のときとそっくり同じように皿の下に入れた。そして夕飯どき、頃合いを見てこう言った。「さあ、いま皿の下に何がいるか教えてもらおうか、フォックスさん?」 するとロビンは言った。「ああ、かわいそうな駒鳥(ロビン)が今日はまんまと捕まった!」
